name: 有据可查 evidence-check
stack: Python（只用标准库）、Agent Skill、promptfoo
one_line: 一个 Agent Skill 加一个核对脚本。
problem: AI 按资料写的回答和草稿，会悄悄改掉日期、数字，或者多出资料里没有的话；要让每句事实都附逐字原文，再用脚本核对。
did: 我把 TraceDesk 里逐字核对引文和数字的规则抽出来，做成谁都能装的 Skill 加核对脚本；先在开发评测里找问题、改出 v0.2，再在冻结的留出题上和普通提示比较；之后按其他几个项目实际使用这个脚本时的误报和待改清单两次改规则（0.3.0、0.4.0），每次改之前先写好新题。
evaluation: **留出评测 v2（144 次对话）**：24 道题，每组 2 遍，3 组共 144 次对话；claude-haiku-5-5，普通接口
**脚本 0.3.0：36 条新说法（只跑脚本）**：36 条说法；确定性脚本，跑 1 遍；不调用模型，不花钱
**脚本 0.4.0：28 条新说法（只跑脚本）**：28 条说法；确定性脚本，跑 1 遍；不调用模型，不花钱
iteration: Skill v0.1 → v0.2：开发评测里两次误报都是正确的翻译、漏掉的一句是算错的时长，于是改成“改写和翻译算有依据、只写资料给的数字”；留出评测里编造数字的回答 2/32 → 0/32。
脚本 0.2.0 → 0.3.0：按其他项目实际使用时的误报加 9 条规则，改之前先写 36 条新说法；正确说法通过 3/16 → 16/16，改错的数字仍全部标出 17/17。
脚本 0.3.0 → 0.4.0：再加 6 条规则（四舍五入、中文序数等），又先写 28 条新说法；正确说法通过 0/11 → 11/11，旧题没有退步。
result: Skill 的作用主要在回答问题时：不再编数字；核对脚本单独用时抓不住意思上的矛盾，所以还要逐条重读通过的说法。
limitations: 题目和 Skill 出自同一作者，资料是虚构的；一个模型、两遍、一天。建议：装进别的 Agent 时，用那个场景自己的资料和错误再测一轮。
脚本单独用时抓不住意思上的矛盾：原文是真的、数字也对，但说法和原文相反，脚本会放行。建议：所以 Skill 要求 Agent 逐条重读通过的说法；要更稳就再加一次独立复核。
中文引文至少要 4 个字，少于 4 个字的完整短句会被挡下；翻译过的组名、离得远的序数还认不出。建议：这几类写进了下一版待改清单，改之前照样先写新题。

name: evidence-check
stack: Python (standard library only), Agent Skill, promptfoo
one_line: An Agent Skill plus a checker script.

facts.label: Stack
facts.value: Python (standard library only), Agent Skill, promptfoo

problem: Answers and drafts written from documents quietly shift dates and numbers or add facts no document states; every factual sentence should carry a word-for-word quote that a script checks.
did: I took TraceDesk's word-for-word quote and number rules out into a skill and checker anyone can install; found problems in a development run, wrote v0.2, and compared it with a plain prompt on frozen held-out items; then revised the rules twice (0.3.0, 0.4.0) from false alarms when other projects used the script and a list of known gaps, writing new items before each change.
evaluation: **Held-out evaluation v2 (144 conversations)**: 24 items, 2 runs per arm, 3 arms, 144 conversations; claude-haiku-5-5, standard API
**Script 0.3.0: 36 new claims (script only)**: 36 claims; Deterministic script, 1 run; No model calls, no cost
**Script 0.4.0: 28 new claims (script only)**: 28 claims; Deterministic script, 1 run; No model calls, no cost
iteration: Skill v0.1 → v0.2: in the development run both false alarms were correct translations and the one miss was a miscalculated duration, so paraphrase and translation now count as supported and only stated numbers may be used; answers with an invented number on the held-out set 2/32 → 0/32.

Script 0.2.0 → 0.3.0: nine rules from false alarms when other projects used the script, with 36 new claims written before the change; correct claims passing 3/16 → 16/16, changed numbers still all flagged 17/17.
Script 0.3.0 → 0.4.0: six more rules (rounding, Chinese ordinals and others), again with 28 new claims written first; correct claims passing 0/11 → 11/11, no regression on earlier items.
result: The skill's effect shows mainly in free answers, which no longer invent numbers; the script alone misses contradictions in meaning, so passing claims are reread one by one.
limitations: Items and skill come from the same author, on fictional documents; one model, two runs, one day. Recommendation: When adding it to another agent, test again with that setting's own documents and errors.

On its own the script misses contradictions in meaning: a real quote with the right numbers can be cited for the opposite claim. Recommendation: That is why the skill makes the agent reread every passing claim; add an independent second check for more safety.

Chinese quotes need at least four characters, so complete shorter phrases are blocked; translated group names and ordinals far from the quote are not yet recognised. Recommendation: These are on the list for the next version, which will again get new items before the change.

problem: 按一个机构自己公开的规定回答问题，每句话逐字引原文；先要把对的那一页找出来。
did: 我们做了按公开规定回答、逐字引原文的问答台：先选校区再提问，检索、生成、在代码里核对引文；用 45 道写好正确页面的题比较 7 种检索做法，再用学生的真实提问单独测。
evaluation: **检索评测：45 道题、7 种做法**：45 道题；每种做法 1 遍；检索在本机跑；中文问题的翻译用 claude-haiku-5-5，普通接口
**学生提的真实问题（另算一套）**：15 个有答案的问题；1 遍；采用的做法，同上
iteration: 检索：比较了 7 种做法，只用向量检索的 MRR 0.709，先翻译再向量检索加重排 0.839，采用后者；中文题进前 5 名 18/20 → 19/20。
资料：最早用无障碍规范（WCAG），换成学生事务的公开页面，因为那才是学生真要问的。
提示词：cairn-monash-v1 → v2，来自最后一轮可读性检查（只说“页面”、不多提校区）。
result: 先翻译再检索、加重排的做法最好；学生的真实提问比自己写的题难。
limitations: 真实提问比自己写的题难：学生问题的 MRR 0.724，自己写的题 0.839；前五名里只漏了断网的线上考试那一题，马来文的问题排第五。建议：上线后把用户的真实问题按同样的方法单独打分，持续盯住这个差距。
没有评测回答本身写得好不好；冒烟测试里有一次把马来西亚校区的问题按澳大利亚的规定回答了。建议：加一套带校区的题，检查答案引用的页面和提问者的校区一致。

one_line: A desk that answers questions from an organisation's published rules and quotes them word for word.

facts.label: Stack
facts.value: Node.js, React, local embedding and reranking, Claude Haiku 5.5

problem: Answer questions from an organisation's own published rules with word-for-word quotes, which first needs the right page to be found.
did: We built a desk that answers from published rules with word-for-word quotes: pick a campus, ask, then retrieval, generation and quote checking in code; seven retrieval methods were compared on 45 questions with known right pages, and real student questions were scored separately.
evaluation: **Retrieval evaluation: 45 questions, 7 methods**: 45 questions; 1 run per method; Retrieval runs locally; Chinese questions are translated with claude-haiku-5-5, standard API
**Real questions from students (scored separately)**: 15 answerable questions; 1 run; Method in use, as above
iteration: Retrieval: seven methods compared; vector search alone has MRR 0.709, translate then vector search with reranking 0.839, which was adopted; Chinese questions in the top five 18/20 → 19/20.
Corpus: started on the accessibility guidelines (WCAG) and switched to public student pages, which students actually need.
Prompt: cairn-monash-v1 → v2, from the final readability review (say "the pages", no needless campus remarks).
result: Translating first, then retrieving with reranking works best; real student questions are harder than the written set.
limitations: Real wording is harder: MRR 0.724 on students' questions against 0.839 on the written set; the only question missing from the top five was an online exam that lost connection, and the Malay question ranked fifth. Recommendation: After launch, score real user questions the same way as a separate set and keep watching the gap.

Answer quality itself is not evaluated; in a smoke test one Malaysia-campus question was answered from Australian rules. Recommendation: Add campus-specific items and check that the cited page matches the asker's campus.

one_line: 一个只按给定资料回答的常见问题助手，为读密集文字吃力的读者设计：先说结论，再列步骤和截止时间，每条都附逐字原文。
problem: 常见问题助手只按给定资料回答，每个回答附逐字原文；截止时间这类关键信息要放在最前、写清出处。
did: 我们做了给读密集文字吃力的读者用的常见问题助手：先一句结论、再一张清单、最后是证据；服务器核对每段引文和每个截止时间；提示词从 grounded-v2 改到 v2.4，v2.2 到 v2.4 每版都和普通提示在同一组题上并排比较（v2.2 用开发组，v2.3、v2.4 用检查组）。
evaluation: **检查组第一轮：普通提示对 grounded-v2.3（20 道题）**：检查组 20 道；每组 1 遍；claude-haiku-5-5，普通接口
**检查组第二轮：普通提示对 grounded-v2.4（同样 20 道题）**：检查组 20 道；每组 1 遍；claude-haiku-5-5，普通接口
iteration: 输出格式改成 v2：加一句话结论和行动清单。
v2.3：每个步骤的截止时间必须挂在这个步骤上、引文里要写着这个时间；检查组第一轮 19/20，普通提示 15/20。
v2.4：截止时间也按读者的语言写；第二轮 20/20，普通提示 17/20（看过第一轮之后跑的，不算干净的留出）。
result: 带出处要求的提示在自动检查上比普通提示好，代价是更贵；第二轮是看过第一轮之后跑的，不算干净的留出。
limitations: 只有 40 道题、虚构资料；第二轮在看过第一轮之后改提示词，不是干净的留出结果。建议：下一版先冻结一组没看过的新题，再比较。
引文核对只证明原文存在，不证明原文支持这句回答；自动检查也会误报，事实对不对要另外逐条核对。建议：加一层意思核对（evidence-check 的做法：通过的说法再逐条重读）。
带出处的提示更贵：同样 20 道题，v2.4 0.0134 美元，普通提示 0.0093 美元。建议：量大时把资料切短再给模型，或缓存不变的部分。

one_line: An FAQ assistant that answers only from the given documents, designed for readers who find dense text hard: bottom line first, then steps and deadlines, each with a word-for-word quote.
problem: An FAQ assistant that answers only from given documents with word-for-word quotes, putting key facts such as deadlines first with their source.
did: We built an FAQ assistant for readers who find dense text hard: one sentence first, then a checklist, then the evidence; the server checks every quote and deadline; the prompt went from grounded-v2 to v2.4, with v2.2 to v2.4 each compared side by side with a plain prompt on the same cases (v2.2 on the development set, v2.3 and v2.4 on the check set).
evaluation: **Check run 1: plain prompt vs grounded-v2.3 (20 cases)**: 20 check cases; 1 run per arm; claude-haiku-5-5, standard API
**Check run 2: plain prompt vs grounded-v2.4 (same 20 cases)**: 20 check cases; 1 run per arm; claude-haiku-5-5, standard API
iteration: Output format v2: a one-line conclusion and a list of next steps.
v2.3: a step's deadline must sit on that step and its quote must state it; check run 1 19/20, plain prompt 15/20.
v2.4: deadlines in the reader's language too; run 2 20/20, plain prompt 17/20 (run after seeing run 1, so not a clean held-out result).
result: The grounded prompt beats the plain prompt on the automatic checks at a higher cost; the second run came after seeing the first, so it is not a clean held-out result.
limitations: Only 40 cases on fictional documents; the second run changed the prompt after seeing the first, so it is not a clean held-out result. Recommendation: For the next version, freeze a new unseen set before comparing.

The quote check proves the quote exists, not that it supports the answer; automatic checks also raise false alarms, so factual correctness needs a separate item-by-item check. Recommendation: Add a meaning check, as evidence-check does by rereading every passing claim.
The grounded prompt costs more: US$0.0134 for v2.4 against US$0.0093 for the plain prompt on the same 20 cases. Recommendation: At volume, send shorter document excerpts or cache the unchanging part.

name: 有据可查的简历初筛
stack: Node.js、Python、evidence-check 0.2.0、批量接口
one_line: 检验一件事：让模型给每个“符合 / 不符合”附上简历原文、再用 evidence-check 的脚本核对，初筛会不会更准、在换掉名字、性别、学校、休学、婚育之后更稳。
problem: 用模型初筛简历时，每个“符合 / 不符合”都要附简历原文；看它会不会更准、换名字性别学校后结论会不会变。
did: 我写了虚构的岗位和简历、事先定好答案，比较不附原文、附原文、附原文加脚本核对几种做法；发现核对的接法会误伤正确的判断以后，改了两版接法；再用带陷阱的新简历、植入错误和第二次独立复核检验。
evaluation: **第一版：准确和稳定（228 个简历版本）**：228 个版本，每组 2 遍，共 1,368 次调用；claude-haiku-5-5，普通接口
**第二版：改核对的接法（12 份新简历）**：48 个版本，4 组各 2 遍，共 384 次对话；claude-haiku-5-5，普通接口
**第三版：更乱、带陷阱的简历（24 份）**：24 份简历、40 个陷阱，3 组各 2 遍；claude-haiku-5-5，批量接口（半价）
**植入错误测试：脚本能拦住什么**：409 条基础回答；确定性脚本，跑 1 遍；不调用模型，不花钱
**第二次独立复核**：143 条，每组 2 遍；claude-haiku-5-5，批量接口（半价）
**第四轮：匿名简历里的民族和性别线索**：每组 288 对（和不加线索的版本配对）；每个版本 2 遍；claude-haiku-5-5，批量接口
iteration: 第一版：把脚本核对直接接在“符合”上，逐条判对只有 2379/2736，原因是“符合”里复述了岗位门槛的数字。
第二版：先拆出“简历事实”再核对，误伤 10/424；再让模型交卷前自己调用核对，误伤 0/422。
植入错误：引文核对拦得住编造，拦不住看错意思（0/40），所以加第二次独立复核，挑出 80/80。
result: 附原文不降准确率，换名字、性别、学校也不改变去留；但核对要接对位置，而且只防编造、不防看错，所以还要第二次复核。
limitations: 简历是虚构的、短的，和答案出自同一作者；一个模型、一个设置。建议：上线前用脱敏的真实简历和招聘团队自己的岗位重测。

name: Evidence-backed resume screening
stack: Node.js, Python, evidence-check 0.2.0, Message Batches API
one_line: Tests whether having the model attach a resume quote to every met / not-met verdict, checked by the evidence-check script, makes screening more accurate and more stable when name, gender, school, career gaps or marital details change.

facts.label: Stack
facts.value: Node.js, Python, evidence-check 0.2.0, Message Batches API

problem: When a model screens resumes, every met / not-met verdict should carry a resume quote; does that make it more accurate, and do verdicts change when name, gender or school change.
did: I wrote fictional jobs and resumes with answers fixed in advance and compared no quotes, quotes, and quotes plus the script; after finding that the check discarded correct verdicts I rewired it twice; then tested with trap-laden new resumes, planted errors and an independent second review.
evaluation: **Round 1: accuracy and stability (228 resume versions)**: 228 versions, 2 runs per arm, 1,368 calls; claude-haiku-5-5, standard API
**Round 2: a better way to wire the check (12 new resumes)**: 48 versions, 4 arms × 2 runs, 384 conversations; claude-haiku-5-5, standard API
**Round 3: messier resumes with traps (24)**: 24 resumes, 40 traps, 3 arms × 2 runs; claude-haiku-5-5, Message Batches API (half price)
**Planted errors: what the script stops**: 409 base answers; Deterministic script, 1 run; No model calls, no cost
**Independent second review**: 143 items, 2 runs per arm; claude-haiku-5-5, Message Batches API (half price)
**Round four: markers of ethnicity and gender in anonymised resumes**: 288 pairs per arm (each against its no-marker version); 2 runs per version; claude-haiku-5-5, Message Batches API
iteration: Round 1: the script wired straight onto "met" verdicts got only 2379/2736 right, because verdicts restated the job's threshold numbers.
Round 2: resume facts split out before the check, 10/424 lost; the model calling the checker itself before submitting, 0/422 lost.
Planted errors: quote checking stops fabrication but not misreading (0/40), so an independent second review was added, catching 80/80.
result: Quotes cost no accuracy and swapping name, gender or school does not change decisions; but the check must be wired in the right place and stops fabrication, not misreading, so a second review is needed.
limitations: Resumes are fictional and short and come from the same author as the answers; one model, one setting. Recommendation: Before launch, re-test on anonymised real resumes and the team's own jobs.
The misreadings were written in, and the review uses the same model as the screening. Recommendation: Use a model from another provider for the review, or review a sample by hand.
One cell of the answer key is disputed, and it is where round three's only wrong cell sits. Recommendation: Mark disputed answers and report them separately from the main metric.

name: 卖点体检
stack: Node.js、DuckDB、Orama、evidence-check、批量接口
one_line: 把商品页的卖点拆开，在买家评价里找支持或反驳的原话，每段原话用 evidence-check 的脚本逐字核对，再给每条卖点贴上“证实、反驳、有争议、没提到”。
problem: 商品页的卖点有没有被买家评价证实：买家只看到被证实的卖点和原话，其余卖点私下交给商家，附修改建议。
did: 我把卖点核对设计成平台和商家一起用的功能：买家只看被证实的卖点，其余私下交给商家；比较三种找证据的做法的准确率和费用；给商家的修改建议迭代了六版，每版先在新写的冻结题上测，再决定用不用。
evaluation: **构造测试集 v1（60 条卖点，答案已知）**：60 条卖点；每种做法 1 遍；claude-haiku-5-5，普通接口
**真实数据（30 个商品，没有标准答案）**：30 个商品、210 条卖点；每种做法 1 遍；A 和 C 另各重跑 1 遍看一致率；claude-haiku-5-5，普通接口
**中文测试集（50 条卖点，网络用语和反话）**：50 条卖点；每种做法 1 遍；claude-haiku-5-5，普通接口
**英文测试集 v2（50 条卖点，长评价、错别字、反话）**：50 条卖点；每种做法 1 遍；claude-haiku-5-5，批量接口（半价）
**检索改进 A2：A 没跑过的 180 条卖点**：四套共 180 条卖点；每种做法 1 遍；claude-haiku-5-5，大部分走批量接口
**修改建议（商家后台）：第 1 版和现在采用的第 5 版**：测试集 40 条；真实数据 151 条；每版生成 1 遍，评分 2 遍；claude-haiku-5-5；第 1 到 3 版普通接口，第 4 到 6 版批量接口
iteration: 找证据的做法：三种比较下来，全部评价一次交给模型（C）最准，费用远低于逐条判断（B），采用。
检索改进 A2：在 A 没见过的题上 167/180 → 173/180，仍不如 C 的 177/180，留作评价太多时的备选。
修改建议：六版，第 2、3、5 版采用，第 4、6 版测完不采用；第 5 版让新文案不再出现“买家说”（140/151 → 151/151）。每一版见 Prompt 资产库。
result: 全部评价一次交给模型最准、费用远低于逐条判断；给商家的修改建议停在第 5 版。
limitations: 测试集的评价比真实评价短、干净；测试题在真实数据跑完之后由同一作者写成。建议：上线前用平台自己的、有许可的评价数据重做一遍真实数据的评测。
真实数据没有标准答案：第二次独立判断和第一次的一致率（C 的支持证据 88%、反驳证据 91%）只说明两次判断接近，不等于判对。建议：上线时抽一部分请人工复核，复核结果回流成新的评测题。
修改建议的评分器和生成建议用的是同一个模型；两次评分之间的一致性中等。建议：换一个不同厂家的模型当第二评分方，或抽样人工评分。
evidence-check 对中文引文要求至少 4 个字，两条完整的 3 个字的标题评价被挡下。建议：核对脚本对“整条评价就是这几个字”的情况放行。

name: Sellpoint Check
stack: Node.js, DuckDB, Orama, evidence-check, Message Batches API
one_line: The listing's claims are split out, buyer reviews are searched for quotes that support or refute each one, every quote is checked word for word by the evidence-check script, and each claim is labelled supported, refuted, mixed or not mentioned.

facts.label: Stack
facts.value: Node.js, DuckDB, Orama, evidence-check, Message Batches API

problem: Which listing claims do buyer reviews confirm: buyers see only confirmed claims with quotes, and the rest go privately to the merchant with suggested rewrites.
did: I designed claim checking as a feature the platform and merchants share: buyers see only confirmed claims, the rest go privately to the merchant; compared three evidence-finding methods on accuracy and cost; and iterated the merchant advice six times, testing each version on new frozen items before deciding.
evaluation: **Constructed set v1 (60 claims, known answers)**: 60 claims; 1 run per method; claude-haiku-5-5, standard API
**Real data (30 products, no answer key)**: 30 products, 210 claims; 1 run per method; A and C were run a second time to measure repeatability; claude-haiku-5-5, standard API
**Chinese set (50 claims, slang and sarcasm)**: 50 claims; 1 run per method; claude-haiku-5-5, standard API
**English set v2 (50 claims, long reviews, typos, sarcasm)**: 50 claims; 1 run per method; claude-haiku-5-5, Message Batches API (half price)
**Retrieval upgrade A2: 180 claims A had not seen**: 180 claims across four sets; 1 run per method; claude-haiku-5-5, mostly Message Batches API
**Rewrite advice (merchant view): v1 and the adopted v5**: 40 test claims; 151 real claims; Generated once per version, graded twice; claude-haiku-5-5; v1–v3 standard API, v4–v6 Message Batches API
iteration: Evidence finding: of the three methods, all reviews in one call (C) was the most accurate and far cheaper than per-review judging (B), and was adopted.
Retrieval upgrade A2: on claims A had not seen, 167/180 → 173/180, still below C's 177/180; kept as the fallback when there are too many reviews.
Rewrite advice: six versions; v2, v3 and v5 adopted, v4 and v6 dropped after testing; v5 removed "buyers say" phrasing from new copy (140/151 → 151/151). Every version is in the prompt registry.
result: Giving the model all reviews in one call is the most accurate and far cheaper than per-review judging; the merchant advice stays at version 5.
limitations: Test reviews are shorter and cleaner than real ones, and the items were written by the same author after the real-data run. Recommendation: Before launch, repeat the real-data evaluation on the platform's own licensed reviews.

Real data has no answer key: agreement between the first and second judgements (C: 88% for supporting and 91% for refuting evidence) shows consistency, not correctness. Recommendation: Sample cases for human review at launch and turn the reviewed cases into new test items.

The advice grader uses the same model as the generator, and agreement between the two gradings is moderate. Recommendation: Use a model from another provider as a second grader, or grade a sample by hand.

evidence-check requires Chinese quotes of at least four characters, which blocked two complete three-character review titles. Recommendation: Let the checker accept a short quote when it is the whole review.

name: 有据审核（广告审核 Agent）
stack: Python、RapidOCR、BM25、evidence-check、Transformers（对比组）、批量接口
one_line: 审核广告的 Agent：读文案和图片里的字，在 32 条政策条款里查依据，给出放行或拒绝；每处违规附类别、条款、违规原话和条款原文，引文先过 evidence-check 的核对脚本才算数。
problem: 广告审核要说得出违反哪一条、是哪几个字违反的，而不只是给“通过 / 拒绝”。
did: 我从官方原文整理了 32 条政策条款，写了带陷阱的留出集，做了能查条款、引原文、多轮改稿和复审的 Agent，并和单个提示词、违禁词表、开源审核模型比较；改稿建议从 v1 迭代到 v1.3；最后换成监管机构和法院定答案的真实广告。
evaluation: **留出集 v1（96 条自己写的广告）**：96 条广告，每组跑两遍，共 192 次判断；claude-haiku-5-5，普通接口
**留出集 v1 的图片广告：不用付费接口的做法**：57 张图；每种做法 1 遍；本机 CPU，不花钱
**难题集（24 条）**：24 条，每组 2 遍；claude-haiku-5-5，批量接口（半价）
**真实广告（英文）：英国广告标准局 30 份公开裁决**：30 份裁决（7 份判不违规），每组 2 遍；claude-haiku-5-5，批量接口（半价）
**真实广告（中文）：16 个公开案例**：16 个案例，每组 2 遍；claude-haiku-5-5，批量接口（半价）
**多轮改稿 mt2：v1 对 v1.1（12 条新广告）**：12 条新广告，每个版本 2 遍，共 24 段对话；claude-haiku-5-5，普通接口
**多轮改稿 mt3：v1.1 对 v1.2（12 条新广告）**：12 条新广告，每个版本 3 遍，共 36 段对话；claude-haiku-5-5，普通接口
**多轮改稿 mt4：v1.1 对 v1.3（12 条新广告）**：12 条新广告，每个版本 3 遍，共 36 段对话；claude-haiku-5-5，普通接口
**记忆评测：给 Agent 看过去确认过的判定（24 条新广告）**：24 条广告，每组 3 遍；claude-haiku-5-5，批量接口（半价）
iteration: 改稿建议 v1.1：改后版本不再留模板占位符，3/24 → 0/24。
v1.2：字段填错就退回重交，没用（4/36 对 6/36），不采用。
v1.3：先填修改后的文案再写说明，字段写错 6/36 → 0/36，费用不变，采用。
题目来源：自己写的留出集和难题集两组都到顶，换成监管机构和法院定答案的真实广告后才分出差别。
result: 自己写的题两组都到顶；换成真实广告后，Agent 比单个提示词更严，大部分错来自监管规则和政策库不同。
limitations: 自己写的题到顶了：留出集两组都接近满分，难题集两组都全对，分不出 Agent 和单个提示词谁更好。建议：要分高低，用不是自己写的题：更多真实裁决、更长的视频，或模型没见过的规则。
Agent 比单个提示词更容易误拒陷阱：留出集陷阱放行 55/60，单个提示词 59/60；Agent 的费用也更高。建议：合规但像违规的广告（送达保证、文化遗产名录、定价）要给 Agent 补正面例子或条款说明。
真实广告上的错大多来自规则不同：英国判不违规的酒类广告，按 TikTok 政策要写酒精度，两组都拒了。建议：上线时政策库要和执行规则的那一方一致；跨市场时按市场分库。
多轮改稿的题只有 12 条短文字广告、一个模型；相差一两段对话属于噪声。建议：下一版改稿提示词上线前，用图片广告和更长的文案再测一轮。
开源审核模型一张图要几分钟，不给条款和原话；SafeGuard-VL-RL 每张图约 178.3 秒。建议：开源模型适合当便宜的第一道筛子，拿不准的再交给带依据的审核。
记忆评测的差别只来自一条广告，题目是自己写的短文字广告，旧判定库也是一起写的。建议：上线前在真实的历史判定和更长的广告上再测；记忆保持只读，写入要经过人工确认。

name: Grounded Review (ad-review agent)
stack: Python, RapidOCR, BM25, evidence-check, Transformers (baselines), Message Batches API
one_line: An agent that reviews ads: it reads the caption and the words in the image, looks up 32 policy clauses, and approves or rejects.

facts.label: Stack
facts.value: Python, RapidOCR, BM25, evidence-check, Transformers (baselines), Message Batches API

problem: An ad decision should name the rule and the exact words that break it, not just approve or reject.
did: I extracted 32 policy clauses from official sources, wrote a held-out set with traps, built an agent that looks up clauses, quotes them, revises and re-reviews over several turns, and compared it with a single prompt, a banned-word list and open-source moderation models; iterated the advice from v1 to v1.3; then switched to real ads judged by regulators and courts.
evaluation: **Held-out set v1 (96 written ads)**: 96 ads, two runs per arm, 192 decisions per arm; claude-haiku-5-5, standard API
**Held-out set v1, image ads: methods without a paid API**: 57 images; 1 run per method; Local CPU, no cost
**Harder set (24 ads)**: 24 ads, 2 runs per arm; claude-haiku-5-5, Message Batches API (half price)
**Real ads (English): 30 published UK ASA rulings**: 30 rulings (7 not upheld), 2 runs per arm; claude-haiku-5-5, Message Batches API (half price)
**Real ads (Chinese): 16 published cases**: 16 cases, 2 runs per arm; claude-haiku-5-5, Message Batches API (half price)
**Multi-turn mt2: v1 vs v1.1 (12 new ads)**: 12 new ads, 2 runs per version, 24 conversations; claude-haiku-5-5, standard API
**Multi-turn mt3: v1.1 vs v1.2 (12 new ads)**: 12 new ads, 3 runs per version, 36 conversations; claude-haiku-5-5, standard API
**Multi-turn mt4: v1.1 vs v1.3 (12 new ads)**: 12 new ads, 3 runs per version, 36 conversations; claude-haiku-5-5, standard API
**Memory test: earlier confirmed decisions shown to the agent (24 new ads)**: 24 ads, 3 runs per arm; claude-haiku-5-5, Message Batches API (half price)
iteration: Advice v1.1: no template placeholders left in corrected versions, 3/24 → 0/24.
v1.2: sending malformed advice back did not help (4/36 vs 6/36) and was dropped.
v1.3: corrected caption before the explanation; advice fields filled wrongly 6/36 → 0/36 at the same cost; adopted.
Item sources: both arms hit the ceiling on written items, and only real ads judged by regulators and courts separated them.
result: Both arms hit the ceiling on written items; on real ads the agent is stricter than the single prompt, and most errors come from the regulator's rules differing from the policy library.
limitations: Written items hit the ceiling: both arms are near-perfect on the held-out set and fully right on the harder set, so they cannot separate the agent from the single prompt. Recommendation: To separate them, use items the author did not write: more real rulings, longer videos, or rules the model has not seen.

The agent rejects more traps: traps approved 55/60 against 59/60 for the single prompt, and it costs more. Recommendation: Add positive examples or clause notes for compliant ads that look like violations (delivery guarantees, heritage listings, set prices).

Most errors on real ads come from different rules: alcohol ads the ASA cleared lack the alcohol-content line TikTok requires, and both arms rejected them. Recommendation: Keep the policy library identical to the rules being enforced; split it by market.

Each multi-turn check uses 12 short text ads and one model; a difference of one or two conversations is noise. Recommendation: Before the next advice prompt ships, test it on image ads and longer captions.

The open-source moderation model takes minutes per image and gives no clause or quote; SafeGuard-VL-RL takes about 178.3 s per image. Recommendation: Use open-source models as a cheap first filter and pass uncertain ads to the grounded review.

The memory result rests on a single ad, and the short text ads and the store of earlier decisions were written together. Recommendation: Before launch, test on real past decisions and longer ads; keep the memory read-only, with writes confirmed by a person.

one_line: 用 20 个固定任务（16 张图、4 段视频）测 Seedream 4.0、4.5、5.0 lite 和 Seedance 1.0 pro 画中文卖点文字稳不稳。

facts.label: 技术
facts.value: BytePlus 接口上的 Seedream 和 Seedance、RapidOCR、浏览器端 OCR

problem: 用 Seedream 做中文电商主图时，画面里的卖点文字能不能一字不差；怎么写提示词、怎么排版，字最稳；上架前怎么核对。
did: 我定了 20 个固定任务、生成前冻结评分表，用 OCR 逐字核对画面里的字，并按评分表独立评三次；把结论写成给商家的创作指南，另做了一个在浏览器里查错字、不上传图片的上线前核对工具。
evaluation: **主评测：16 个图片任务、4 个视频任务**：每个图片版本 16 张，视频 4 段；每个任务生成 1 次；观感评分 3 次；BytePlus 接口，免费额度
iteration: 主评测之后做了提示词小实验：写明字的颜色有效，被采用；“大号标题、上方留白”不一定管用，改成“生成后看一眼标题有没有被裁”。
视频里的字三种改法都保不住，指南统一写成“视频里的字后期再叠”。
对外定位从“版本评测”改成给商家的创作指南，数据不变；另做了上线前核对工具。
result: 图片里的字基本都写对，视频里的字保不住；观感上 4.5 和 4.0 差不多，5.0 lite 明显低。
limitations: 样本小：16 个图片任务、4 个视频任务，每个只生成一次；视频只有 1/4 段字全对。建议：视频里的字后期再叠，不靠模型生成。
观感评分没有和买家盲评对照；三次评分来自同一种评分方式。建议：上线前请几位真实买家盲评一小组作品，看和评分表的结论是否一致。
提示词小实验只有几张图：写明字色有效，“大号标题、上方留白”不一定管用。建议：生成后看一眼标题有没有被裁掉，被裁就重新生成。

name: Text on Product: Chinese copy on AI product images
stack: Seedream and Seedance through the BytePlus API, RapidOCR, in-browser OCR
one_line: Twenty fixed tasks (16 images, 4 videos) test how reliably Seedream 4.0, 4.5 and 5.0 lite and Seedance 1.0 pro render Chinese selling-point text.

facts.label: Stack
facts.value: Seedream and Seedance through the BytePlus API, RapidOCR, in-browser OCR

problem: When Seedream makes Chinese product images, does the selling-point text come out exactly; how to write and lay it out so the text holds; how to check before listing.
did: I fixed 20 tasks and froze the rubric before generation, checked the text in every image character by character with OCR and rated each work three times against the rubric; turned the findings into a guide for merchants and built an in-browser pre-listing checker that never uploads the image.
evaluation: **Main evaluation: 16 image tasks and 4 video tasks**: 16 images per image version, 4 videos; 1 generation per task; 3 ratings; BytePlus API, free quota
iteration: After the main evaluation, a prompt mini-experiment: stating the text colour worked and was adopted; asking for a large title with top margin did not reliably help, so the guide says to check whether the title was clipped.
None of three changes kept video text stable, so the guide says to add video text in editing.
The public framing moved from a version comparison to a guide for merchants, with the same data; a pre-listing checker was added.
result: Image text is almost always right and video text does not hold; in appearance 4.5 and 4.0 are close and 5.0 lite is clearly lower.
limitations: Small sample: 16 image and 4 video tasks, one generation each; only 1/4 videos have exactly right text. Recommendation: Add text to videos in editing rather than relying on generation.

Ratings were not compared with blind ratings by buyers; all three come from the same rating method. Recommendation: Before launch, have a few real buyers blind-rate a small set and compare with the rubric.

The prompt mini-experiment has only a few images: stating the text colour worked, asking for a large title with top margin did not reliably help. Recommendation: After generation, check whether the title was clipped and regenerate if so.

name: 实时语音 Agent 体验评测
stack: Python、SenseVoice、本机 MCP 工具、FireRedChat pVAD、Claude Haiku 5.5
one_line: 测一条串联的实时语音 Agent（静音检测 → 语音识别 → 带工具的模型 → 语音合成）在 42 段写好的中英对话里的表现：停顿、插话、附和词、噪声、工具调用。

facts.label: 技术
facts.value: Python、SenseVoice、本机 MCP 工具、FireRedChat pVAD、Claude Haiku 5.5

problem: 语音助手在用户停顿、插话、说“嗯”、背景有人说话时还能不能把事办对，体验用时延、打断、误停的数字来衡量（用户语音是合成的）。
did: 我写了 42 段带停顿、插话、附和和噪声的对话、事先定好答案，搭了一条本机串联的语音 Agent 做基线；然后一项一项试改进，每项先写补充预注册再跑，最后把有效的合在一起。
evaluation: **主评测：三种基线设置和纯文字对照（42 段对话）**：42 段对话，每种设置 2 遍，共 84 段；claude-haiku-5-5，普通流式接口
**逐项改进（同一套 42 段对话）**：42 段对话，每种设置 2 遍；claude-haiku-5-5，普通流式接口
iteration: 附和不算打断、声音至少 0.5 秒才算插话、先暂停再确认是不是真插话：一项一项试下来，“嗯”“好的”“Okay”不再让它停下或只停一下就接着说，单项改进时“嗯嗯”仍会打断。
只听主说话人（pVAD）：背景人声时开口 20.4 秒 → 4.56 秒，三项改进里效果最大。
四项合在一起：严格通过 62/84，真插话仍然 16/16 停下。
result: 四项改进合在一起，在这几项改动针对的问题上是测过最好的设置：背景人声不再占住对话、真插话一停就停、每次附和后回答都保住了；按事先写好的严格通过和基线持平。“嗯嗯”仍被识别成别的字，合在一起时只因为发声时间刚好不到 0.5 秒才没打断，余量很小，光看文字分不出附和。
limitations: 用户语音是合成的，时间是模拟的；42 段对话每种设置只跑两遍，相差一两段属于噪声。建议：上线前用真人录音（例如公开的对话语音数据）重跑，并在真实网络下测时延。
“嗯嗯”这类附和仍被识别器听成别的字：单项改进时它会打断，四项合在一起时只因为发声时间刚好不到 0.5 秒才没打断，余量很小；光看识别出的文字分不出附和和短插话。建议：用看声音本身的附和检测；现成的声学附和模型离线试过，没达到事先定的标准，所以没接进来。
没有和端到端实时语音模型比较。建议：接上一个有免费额度的端到端模型，用同一套题和同一个打分脚本比较。

name: Real-time voice agent evaluation
stack: Python, SenseVoice, local MCP tools, FireRedChat pVAD, Claude Haiku 5.5
one_line: Measures a cascaded real-time voice agent (voice activity detection → speech recognition → a model with tools → speech synthesis) on 42 scripted Chinese and English conversations covering pauses, interruptions, backchannels, noise and tool calls.

facts.label: Stack
facts.value: Python, SenseVoice, local MCP tools, FireRedChat pVAD, Claude Haiku 5.5

problem: Whether a voice assistant still gets the task right when the user pauses, interrupts, says "mm" or talks over background speech, with experience measured as latency, barge-in and false-stop numbers (the user's speech is synthesised).
did: I wrote 42 conversations with pauses, barge-ins, backchannels and noise, answers fixed in advance, and built a local cascaded voice agent as the baseline; then tried fixes one at a time, each with its own preregistration addendum, and combined the ones that worked.
evaluation: **Main run: three baseline settings and a text-only control (42 conversations)**: 42 conversations, 2 runs per setting, 84 in all; claude-haiku-5-5, standard streaming API
**Fixes one at a time (same 42 conversations)**: 42 conversations, 2 runs per setting; claude-haiku-5-5, standard streaming API
iteration: Backchannels not counted as barge-ins, a 0.5 s minimum before a barge-in counts, pause before cancelling: tried one at a time, "mm", "okay" and "好的" no longer stop it or only pause it briefly, though with any single fix "mm-mm" still interrupts.
Primary-speaker VAD: first audio over background speech 20.4 s → 4.56 s, the largest effect of the three fixes.
All four together: strict pass 62/84, real barge-ins still stopped 16/16.
result: Together the four fixes are the best setting tested on the problems they target: background talk no longer holds the turn, a real barge-in stops at once and every reply survives its backchannel; on the strict pass written beforehand they are level with the baseline. "Mm-mm" is still transcribed as other words and only avoids an interruption because its voiced time falls just under 0.5 s, a thin margin; text alone cannot tell a backchannel.
limitations: User speech is synthesised and time is simulated; with 42 conversations and two runs per setting, a difference of one or two is noise. Recommendation: Before launch, rerun with recorded human speech (for example a public dialogue speech set) and measure latency on a real network.

Backchannels such as "mm-mm" are still heard as other words: with single fixes they interrupt, and with all four they avoid it only because their voiced time falls just under 0.5 s, a thin margin; text alone cannot tell a backchannel from a short barge-in. Recommendation: Use detection on the audio itself; an off-the-shelf acoustic backchannel model was tried offline and missed the preset bar, so it was not added.
No end-to-end real-time speech model was compared. Recommendation: Add an end-to-end model with a free tier and compare it on the same items and scorer.

name: 有据标注流水线
stack: Python、Pandas、DuckDB（SQL）、BM25 和本机向量检索（Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B）、evidence-check、Lark 多维表格（工作流和 AI Agent 步骤）、批量接口
one_line: 一条围绕有据审核搭的审核和标注工作流。

facts.label: 技术
facts.value: Python、Pandas、DuckDB（SQL）、BM25 和本机向量检索（Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B）、evidence-check、Lark 多维表格（工作流和 AI Agent 步骤）、批量接口

problem: 能核对的回答，怎么变成团队每天用的审核工作流：拿不准的交给人复核，提示词能灰度、能回滚。
did: 我把有据审核做成一条四步审核工作流：模型判断，evidence-check 核对引文，核对没过或模型拿不准的进人工复核队列，复核结果回流成回归题；另加政策库检索评测、只按政策库回答的知识库问答、提示词版本、灰度和回滚规则、用 SQL 取数的每周报告和上线检查清单，并在 Lark 多维表格里搭了判断和复核两条工作流。
evaluation: **回归测试：分流提示词 v1 对 v2（332 个回放请求）**：332 个请求，每个版本 1 遍；claude-haiku-5-5，批量接口（半价）
**灰度回放：按事先写好的回滚规则（回放，不是真实用户）**：四周，共 332 个请求；回放 1 遍；不调用模型，回放存下的答案
**第二轮灰度：改好的规则，新写的广告**：240 个请求；每条广告两遍，每个版本 1 遍；claude-haiku-5-5，批量接口（半价）
**Lark 里的工作流：平台 AI Agent 步骤（25 条中文广告）**：25 条广告，每条一遍；Lark 多维表格 AI Agent 步骤（Seed 1.8）
**政策库检索：正确条款进前三（124 条违规标注）**：124 条违规标注；确定性检索，1 遍；不调用模型，用 v1 第一遍存下的答案
**提示词第 3 版：新写的广告上不采用**：240 个请求（另有回归 332 个）；每条广告两遍，每个版本 1 遍；claude-haiku-5-5，批量接口（半价）
**提示词第 4 版：又一批新写的广告上不采用**：240 个请求（另有回归 332 个）；每条广告两遍，每个版本 1 遍；claude-haiku-5-5，批量接口（半价）
**政策知识库问答：只按检索到的条款回答（80 道题）**：160 个请求；每道题 2 遍；claude-haiku-5-5，批量接口；中文检索 BM25，英文检索 Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B，取前 5 条
**英文条款检索换成本机向量模型（选方法时没用过的标注）**：第二轮 40 条、第三轮 23 条英文违规标注；确定性检索，1 遍；Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B（量化版，fastembed），本机运行，不调用接口
**Lark 两条工作流：判断和复核（60 条中文广告，两遍）**：60 条广告；2 遍（第二遍改过才跑）；Lark 多维表格工作流；AI Agent 步骤用平台模型 Seed 1.8，平台免费额度
iteration: v1：四步工作流跑通，但判错的 17/332 全部自动生效，引文核对拦不住看错的判断。
v2：让模型说“拿不准”，拿不准的交人工；判错又自动生效的降到 9/332，四条采用标准都满足。
第一轮灰度：按事先写好的回滚规则，放到 10% 就回滚了；复盘发现两条规则写错（和改动目的矛盾、样本太小就比比例）。
第二轮灰度：改好的规则跑前预注册，在新写的广告上三步放量都没回滚，v2 转为正式版本；但两版在这批广告上都接近全对，没有再证明 v2 能少漏错判。
Lark：在多维表格里搭了同样的工作流，用平台自带的 AI Agent 步骤判断、写回，拿不准的自己进复核队列，引文核对由脚本补；另有一个聊天机器人，测试时发过几条广告和几个政策问题，只是测试、没有使用量。
v3：重写“拿不准”的规则，想让答案清楚的广告少送人工；清楚广告的多余复核从 44/176 降到 4/176，但要人来定的广告送人工也从 44/64 降到 19/64，超过事先写好的上限，不采用，production 留在 v2。
v4：两头都比 v2 好，清楚广告的多余复核 43/176 → 11/176，要人来定的送人工 42/64 → 47/64；但判错时更常说“确定”，清楚广告判错又自动生效 0/176 → 2/176，回归漏网 9/332 → 13/332，不采用。
知识库问答：只按检索到的条款回答，库里没有就说没有；答对 134/160，库里没有的题说了“没有” 44/48。
英文条款检索换成本机向量模型：在选方法时没用过的标注上，正确条款进前三从 21/23 到 23/23；中文还用 BM25。
每周指标改用 SQL 取数，和原来的数逐个比过：整数全同，少数小数只在最末几位有差别（求和顺序不同），周报页面一字不差。
Lark 两条工作流：第一遍条款里的换行挡住了平台的逐字查找，两种引文核对一致 49/60，不一致的都是多送了人工；改好后第二遍 60/60（看过第一遍才改，不算预注册）。
result: 让模型说“拿不准”能减少判错又生效，代价是多送人工；第一轮灰度按规则回滚，暴露的是规则本身写错；改好的规则在新流量上放到全量，v2 转为正式版本。v2 少漏错判的证据仍来自第一轮。第 3 版在清楚广告上少了多余复核，却把要人来定的广告也少送了人工；第 4 版两头都好了，判错时却更常说“确定”。两版都按事先写好的标准没采用；假如照样放量，灰度规则都拦不下，拦下它们的是题目设计和采用标准。
limitations: 流量是评测题的回放，不是真实用户；复核结论用的是题目定好的答案，没有真的审核员。建议：上线后按版本统计真实请求的漏网错判和复核量，抽检结果回流成回归题。
v2 少放过判错，但送人工从 6/332 涨到 72/332，很多是清楚的广告也说“拿不准”。建议：第 3 版放宽“拿不准”，要人来定的也少送了；第 4 版两头都好了，判错时却更常说“确定”。下一版要同时守住三头：清楚的少送、要人定的不少送、判错的不放过，同样先过回归和新题再灰度。
第二轮在新流量上放到全量，但两版在这批广告上都接近全对，没有再证明 v2 能少漏错判；v2 的好处仍来自第一轮。建议：再找 v1 会漏判的新广告（例如更长、更含糊的），在同样的规则下比一次。
Lark 里的平台模型一次也没说拿不准（0/25），分流模型的存档答案里却有 13/50 说了；机器人问答只有测试，没有真实使用量。建议：换模型后先重新量复核率，再调“拿不准”的门槛；机器人先用一批问题测，再看真实的使用记录。
中文问题的检索偏弱：算对的条款进前 5 只有 23/28，库里有答案却说“没有”的都出在检索没找到。建议：中文检索也试本机向量或混合检索，先在选方法时没用过的问题上验。

name: Grounded Labelling Pipeline
stack: Python, Pandas, DuckDB (SQL), BM25 and local embedding retrieval (Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B), evidence-check, Lark Base (workflows and the AI Agent step), Message Batches API
one_line: A review and labelling workflow built around Grounded Review.

facts.label: Stack
facts.value: Python, Pandas, DuckDB (SQL), BM25 and local embedding retrieval (Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B), evidence-check, Lark Base (workflows and the AI Agent step), Message Batches API

problem: How checkable answers become a review workflow a team runs daily: unsure cases go to people, and prompts ship with canary release and rollback.
did: I turned Grounded Review into a four-step review workflow: the model decides, evidence-check verifies the quotes, ads that fail the check or that the model is unsure of go to a human review queue, and reviewed ads come back as regression items; plus a policy retrieval evaluation, a knowledge-base Q&A that answers only from the policy library, prompt versions, canary and rollback rules, weekly reports computed in SQL and a launch checklist, with judging and review workflows built in a Lark Base.
evaluation: **Regression test: triage prompt v1 vs v2 (332 replayed requests)**: 332 requests, 1 run per version; claude-haiku-5-5, Message Batches API (half price)
**Canary replay under the rules written beforehand (a replay, not real users)**: Four weeks, 332 requests; 1 replay; No model calls; stored answers replayed
**Canary round two: fixed rules on newly written ads**: 240 requests; Two runs per ad, 1 run per version; claude-haiku-5-5, Message Batches API (half price)
**The workflow in Lark: the platform AI Agent step (25 Chinese ads)**: 25 ads, one run each; Lark Base AI Agent step (Seed 1.8)
**Policy retrieval: right clause in the top three (124 labelled violations)**: 124 labelled violations; Deterministic retrieval, 1 run; No model calls; v1's stored first-run answers
**Prompt v3 on newly written ads: not adopted**: 240 requests (plus 332 in the regression); Two runs per ad, 1 run per version; claude-haiku-5-5, Message Batches API (half price)
**Prompt v4 on another set of newly written ads: not adopted**: 240 requests (plus 332 in the regression); Two runs per ad, 1 run per version; claude-haiku-5-5, Message Batches API (half price)

**Policy knowledge-base Q&A: answers only from retrieved clauses (80 questions)**: 160 requests; 2 runs per question; claude-haiku-5-5, Message Batches API; BM25 for Chinese, Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B for English, top 5 clauses

**English clause retrieval on a local embedding model (labels not used to choose it)**: 40 round-two and 23 round-three English violation labels; Deterministic retrieval, 1 run; Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B (quantised, fastembed), run locally, no API calls

**Two Lark workflows: judging and review (60 Chinese ads, two passes)**: 60 ads; 2 passes (the second after the fix); Lark Base workflows; the AI Agent step uses the platform model Seed 1.8 on the free allowance
iteration: v1: the four-step workflow runs, but all 17/332 wrong decisions went live; quote checks cannot stop a misread decision.
v2: the model may say it is unsure, and unsure ads go to people; wrong decisions that went live fell to 9/332, meeting all four adoption criteria.
Canary round one: under the rules written beforehand it rolled back at 10%; the review found two wrong rules (at odds with the change's purpose, and comparing rates on too few requests).

Canary round two: the fixed rules were preregistered, and on newly written ads all three release steps passed without a rollback, so v2 was promoted to production; but both versions were almost always right on these ads, so this did not show again that v2 lets fewer errors through.

Lark: the same workflow built in a Lark Base, with the platform's AI Agent step deciding and writing back, unsure answers queued for review, and quote checks added by script; plus a chat bot, tried with a few ads and policy questions as tests, with no real usage.

v3: the rule on when to be unsure was rewritten so that clear ads go to people less often; needless reviews of clear ads fell from 44/176 to 4/176, but ads that need a human were also sent to people less often, 44/64 to 19/64, past the limit set beforehand, so it was not adopted and production stays on v2.

v4: better than v2 at both ends, needless reviews of clear ads 43/176 → 11/176 and ads that need a human sent to people 42/64 → 47/64; but more often sure when wrong, with clear ads decided wrongly and gone live 0/176 → 2/176 and regression escapes 9/332 → 13/332, so it was not adopted.
Knowledge-base Q&A: answers only from retrieved clauses and says so when the library has none; answered right 134/160, and said "not in the library" 44/48 when it was not.
English clause retrieval switched to a local embedding model: on labels not used to choose it, the right clause in the top three went from 21/23 to 23/23; Chinese stays on BM25.

Weekly metrics are now computed in SQL and were compared one by one with the earlier numbers: every integer is the same, a few decimals differ only in their last digits (sums added in a different order), and the report pages are identical.

Two Lark workflows: on the first pass, line breaks in the clauses blocked the platform's exact-text search, so the two quote checks agreed on 49/60, every disagreement sending an extra ad to people; after the fix the second pass agreed on 60/60 (changed after seeing the first pass, so not preregistered).
result: Letting the model say it is unsure reduces wrong decisions that go live at the cost of more human review; the first canary rolled back because the rules themselves were wrong; with fixed rules the second canary on new traffic reached full release and v2 was promoted to production. The evidence that v2 lets fewer errors through still comes from round one. Version 3 cut needless reviews of clear ads but also sent fewer ads that need a human to people; version 4 improved both but was more often sure when wrong. Neither met the standard written beforehand; a canary would not have stopped either, the item design and the adoption standard did.
limitations: Traffic replays test items rather than real users, and reviewer decisions are the items' fixed answers, not real reviewers. Recommendation: After launch, track wrong decisions let through and review volume per version on real requests, and feed QA samples back as regression items.

v2 lets fewer wrong decisions through, but human review rose from 6/332 to 72/332, often on clear ads the model called unsure. Recommendation: Version 3 relaxed "unsure" and sent fewer ads that need a human to people; version 4 improved both ends but was more often sure when wrong. The next version has to hold all three: fewer clear ads sent, no fewer ads that need a human, and no wrong decisions let through, again through a regression and new items before a canary.

Round two reached full release on new traffic, but both versions were almost always right on those ads, so it did not show again that v2 lets fewer errors through; that evidence still comes from round one. Recommendation: Find new ads that v1 misses (longer or vaguer ones) and compare again under the same rules.

The Lark platform model never said it was unsure (0/25), while the triage model did in 13/50 stored answers; the bot's Q&A has only been tested, with no real usage. Recommendation: After a model change, measure the review rate again before tuning the unsure threshold; test the bot on a batch of questions, then read its real usage log.

Retrieval for Chinese questions is weak: the right clause was in the top five for only 23/28, and every "not in the library" on an answerable question came from retrieval missing it. Recommendation: Try embedding or hybrid retrieval for Chinese too, checked first on questions not used to choose the method.

name: 有据经营分析
stack: Python、DuckDB（SQL）、Pandas、evidence-check 0.4.0、批量接口、Excel、Dify
one_line: 在一份合成的到店团购数据上，把“每周监控 → 按维度拆解 → 写经营周报 → 数字核对”做成一条可以重跑的线，并比较三种找原因的做法：固定规则的脚本、把固定查询结果交给模型的一次提示词、让模型自己用工具查数的 Agent。
problem: 每周看经营数据的人要知道哪些指标异动、原因在哪；让模型找原因、写周报，原因找得准不准，周报里的数字能不能都对回查询结果（在合成数据上测）。
did: 我在合成的到店团购数据上搭了指标字典、一条 SQL 的周监控、贡献度和率效应拆解、带数字核对的经营周报，比较固定脚本、一次提示词和 Agent 三种找原因的做法；埋好答案的测试题和评测计划在跑之前冻结；另把同一条流程搭成 Dify 工作流。
evaluation: **测试集：埋好答案的题（脚本、一次提示词、Agent）**：36 道题；每种做法每题 1 遍；claude-haiku-5-5，effort medium，批量接口；脚本不调用模型
**开发集：用来写规则和提示词（第 4 版）**：16 道题；每种做法每题 1 遍；claude-haiku-5-5，effort medium，批量接口
iteration: 先把指标字典、周监控、拆解和数字核对搭成一条线，三种做法共用。
脚本的下钻规则在开发集上重写一次：先定环节再定分组，已找到的原因能解释的分组不再报。
提示词 v1 到 v4：有的稿子删掉数字来过核对，第 3 版起要求“发现”段必须有数字、“原因”段必须引用行；第 4 版写明中文数字也会被核对。
开发集上第 4 版：脚本 12/16，一次提示词 13/16，Agent 16/16；随后冻结文件指纹，再跑测试集。
测试集：Agent 34/36，脚本 31/36，一次提示词 28/36；两个维度交叉的原因，一次提示词 0/6。
Dify 版：同一条“一次提示词”流程搭成 Dify 工作流，几个场景周试跑过，不在评测里。
result: 让模型自己决定查什么，原因找得最准，两个维度交叉的原因尤其明显；代价是第一稿更常引错行，费用约是一次提示词的 1.8 倍。固定脚本在单一原因上不差，这批题分不出它和 Agent 的高下。数字核对拦住了引错行的数，但对中文数字太严，把没有错数的周报也拦下了。
limitations: 数据、埋的事件、监控和三种做法都出自同一个项目；埋的事件干净，都落在现有维度里，真实的原因常常不是这样。建议：换到真实数据前，先拿历史上已经查清原因的周做一批题再测。
Agent 和脚本只差几题（p = 0.45），这批题分不出高下。建议：要分出高下得加题，尤其是两个原因和两个维度交叉的题。
数字核对对中文数字太严：最后没放行的周报里没有一个错数，没过的段落都卡在“这两项”“前一天”这类词上。建议：把计数词和数量分开处理，或给计数词单独的规则；严到什么程度是产品上的取舍，要和使用的人一起定。
Agent 第一稿引了不在引用行里的数的段落有 19 段，靠退回改一次才全部改好；没有核对就会发出去。建议：核对放在发出之前，不能省。
建议没有打分。建议：给建议定评分规则，再在同一批题上测。

name: Grounded Business Review
stack: Python, DuckDB (SQL), Pandas, evidence-check 0.4.0, Message Batches API, Excel, Dify
one_line: On synthetic local-services group-buying data, "weekly monitor → breakdown by dimension → weekly review → number check" runs as one repeatable line, and three ways of finding the cause are compared: a fixed-rule script, a one-prompt approach that hands the model a fixed pack of query results, and an agent that queries with tools.

facts.label: Stack
facts.value: Python, DuckDB (SQL), Pandas, evidence-check 0.4.0, Message Batches API, Excel, Dify

problem: Whoever reads the weekly numbers needs to know which metrics moved and why; when a model finds the cause and writes the review, is the cause right, and does every number trace back to a query result? (tested on synthetic data).
did: On synthetic local-services group-buying data I built a metric dictionary, a one-query weekly monitor, contribution and rate-mix breakdowns and number-checked weekly reviews, and compared three ways of finding the cause: a fixed-rule script, a one-prompt approach and an agent; the known-answer test cases and the evaluation plan were frozen before the run; the same flow was also built as a Dify workflow.
evaluation: **Test set: known-answer cases (script, one prompt, agent)**: 36 cases; 1 run per case per approach; claude-haiku-5-5, effort medium, Message Batches API; the script makes no model calls
**Development set: used to write the rules and prompts (version 4)**: 16 cases; 1 run per case per approach; claude-haiku-5-5, effort medium, Message Batches API
iteration: First the metric dictionary, weekly monitor, breakdowns and number check were built as one line shared by all three approaches.
The script's drill-down was rewritten once on the development set: stage first, then segment, and segments the found cause already explains are dropped.
Prompts v1 to v4: some drafts passed the check by dropping their numbers, so from v3 a finding must contain a number and a cause must cite a row; v4 says Chinese number words are checked too.
Version 4 on the development set: script 12/16, one prompt 13/16, agent 16/16; then the file fingerprints were frozen and the test set ran.
Test set: agent 34/36, script 31/36, one prompt 28/36; on causes that cross two dimensions the one prompt got 0/6.
Dify version: the same one-prompt flow built as a Dify workflow and tried on a few scenario weeks; not in the evaluation.
result: Letting the model decide what to query finds causes best, most clearly when a cause crosses two dimensions; the price is first drafts that cite the wrong row more often and about 1.8× the one prompt's cost. The fixed script does well on single causes, and these cases cannot separate it from the agent. The number check stopped every number quoted from the wrong row, but it is too strict on Chinese number words and also held back reviews with no wrong number.
limitations: The data, the planted events, the monitor and all three approaches come from the same project; the events are clean and sit inside existing dimensions, which real causes often do not. Recommendation: Before real data, build cases from past weeks whose causes are already known and test again.
The agent and the script differ by a few cases (p = 0.45); these cases cannot separate them. Recommendation: Separating them needs more cases, especially two-cause and two-dimension ones.

The number check is too strict on Chinese number words: the reviews held back in the end had no wrong number, and their failing paragraphs failed on words like 这两项 ("these two") or 前一天 ("the day before"). Recommendation: Treat counting words apart from quantities, or give them their own rule; how strict to be is a product decision to make with the people who use it.

The agent's first drafts had 19 paragraphs quoting a number not in the cited row, all fixed only by the one revision; without the check they would have gone out. Recommendation: Keep the check before anything goes out.
Recommended actions are not scored. Recommendation: Write scoring rules for the actions and test them on the same cases.

name: 创作者 Skill 合集
stack: Agent Skills（SKILL.md 加 Python 脚本，只用标准库）、Claude Code 插件、批量接口
one_line: 三个给短视频创作者用的 Agent Skill，各带一个核对脚本，结果交出去之前先查一遍。

facts.label: 技术
facts.value: Agent Skills（SKILL.md 加 Python 脚本，只用标准库）、Claude Code 插件、批量接口

problem: 创作者每周都要对字幕、排分镜、追热点；交给 AI 助手做时，字幕会不会被改错、分镜里的口播念不念得完、热点选题卡上的事实站不站得住。
did: 我做了三个给短视频创作者用的 Agent Skill：字幕对稿、分镜核对、热点选题。每个都带一个核对脚本，结果交出去之前先查一遍。每个都和不装 Skill 的同一个模型在事先定好答案的题上比较，计划和预测跑前冻结。
evaluation: **字幕对稿：自动字幕对回口播稿**：10 段字幕，每组 20 次；每段每组 2 遍；claude-haiku-5-5，effort medium，批量接口
**分镜核对第一轮：请求里写明语速**：10 段稿子，每组 20 次；每段每组 2 遍；claude-haiku-5-5，effort medium，批量接口
**分镜核对第二轮：请求里不写语速（新写的题）**：10 段稿子，每组 20 次；每段每组 2 遍；claude-haiku-5-5，effort medium，批量接口；按默认语速核对
**热点选题：每张选题卡上的事实带出处**：10 个热点，每组 20 次；每个每组 2 遍；claude-haiku-5-5，effort medium，批量接口
iteration: 字幕对稿：两组都能改对听错的字；差别在别的地方，不装 Skill 时常改动时间轴、把口播时临时改的话改回原稿，装了以后两样都不碰。
分镜核对第一轮（请求里写明语速和计数方法）：不装 Skill 也几乎全过（19/20），预测的“最多一半”没成立，题目到顶了。
分镜核对第二轮（新写的题，请求里不写语速，像创作者平时那样问）：不装 Skill 一张都没过（0/20），装了全过（20/20）。
热点选题：两组的出处大多核对得上；不装 Skill 时会给有伤亡的事件出营销卡，数字也偶尔不在引文里。
result: 三个 Skill 的作用都在核对这一步：字幕不再被改动时间轴和口播原话；分镜的差别要到请求不写语速时才显出来；热点选题遇到有伤亡的事件不出营销卡。代价是多调用几次模型，热点选题的费用约是不装的 2.9 倍。
limitations: 题目都是合成的，写题时就想着 Skill 能查出来的问题；真实音频、口音、背景音乐和多人说话都没覆盖。建议：上线前拿真实视频的自动字幕和真实热点再测一批。
一个模型，每题每组两遍，差一两题算噪声。建议：换模型或改 effort 时重新跑同一套题。
分镜的差别只在请求不写语速时出现：写明语速时不装 Skill 也有 19/20。建议：看用户平时怎么提需求，决定这个 Skill 值不值得默认装上。
热点选题只查事实的出处和伤亡事件，不评选题的创意和是否适合账号。建议：创意和账号是否合适另定评分规则再测。

stack: Agent Skills (SKILL.md plus standard-library Python scripts), Claude Code plugin, Message Batches API
one_line: Three Agent Skills for short-video creators, each with a checking script that uses only the Python standard library.

facts.label: Stack
facts.value: Agent Skills (SKILL.md plus standard-library Python scripts), Claude Code plugin, Message Batches API

problem: Creators fix subtitles, plan shot lists and chase trends weekly. When an assistant does it, do subtitles stay right, can every shot be spoken in time, and do trend facts hold?
did: I built three Agent Skills for short-video creators: subtitle checking, shot-list checking and trend topics. Each carries a checking script that runs before anything is handed back. Each was compared with the same model without the skill on items whose answers were fixed in advance, with plans and predictions frozen before the runs.
evaluation: **Subtitle checking: auto-captions against the script**: 10 subtitle files, 20 runs per arm; claude-haiku-5-5, effort medium, Message Batches API
**Shot lists, round one: the request states the rates**: 10 scripts, 20 runs per arm; claude-haiku-5-5, effort medium, Message Batches API
**Shot lists, round two: no rates in the request (new items)**: 10 scripts, 20 runs per arm; claude-haiku-5-5, effort medium, Message Batches API; checked at the default rates
**Trend topics: every fact on a card carries its source**: 10 trends, 20 runs per arm; claude-haiku-5-5, effort medium, Message Batches API
iteration: Subtitles: both arms fix the misheard words; the difference lies elsewhere, as without the skill the model often moves timings or turns ad-libs back into the script, and with it does neither.
Shot lists, round one (the request states the rates and how to count): even without the skill almost every list passed (19/20); the predicted "at most half" did not hold, a ceiling.
Shot lists, round two (new items, the request gives no rates, as creators usually ask): without the skill none passed (0/20), with it all did (20/20).
Trend topics: most sources check out in both arms; without the skill the model makes marketing cards for events with casualties, and a number is sometimes missing from its quote.
result: In all three skills the value is in the check: subtitles no longer lose their timings or the speaker's own words; the shot-list difference only shows when the request gives no rates; trend topics make no marketing cards for events with casualties. The price is a few more model calls; trend topics cost about 2.9× as much as without the skill.
limitations: All items are synthetic and written with the skills' checks in mind; real audio, accents, music and several speakers are not covered. Recommendation: Before release, test again on real auto-captions and real trends.
One model and two runs per item per arm; a difference of one or two items is noise. Recommendation: Run the same items again after a model or effort change.

The shot-list gap appears only when the request gives no rates: with the rates stated, even without the skill 19/20 passed. Recommendation: Look at how users actually ask before deciding whether to install this skill by default.

Trend topics checks only the sources of facts and casualty events, not the quality of the ideas or their fit to the account. Recommendation: Write separate scoring rules for ideas and account fit, then test.

name: 审核模型实验
stack: Python、PyTorch、LoRA 微调（Qwen3）、本机视觉语言模型（Qwen3.5、Qwen3-VL）、SigLIP 2、mmBERT、OCR、批量接口
one_line: 按广告政策审核短视频广告的三组实验，都在一台笔记本显卡上跑，方案和预测跑前预注册。

facts.label: 技术
facts.value: Python、PyTorch、LoRA 微调（Qwen3）、本机视觉语言模型（Qwen3.5、Qwen3-VL）、SigLIP 2、mmBERT、OCR、批量接口

problem: 按广告政策审核短视频广告，模型要看到什么才够；用合成广告训练的小模型能不能胜任。
did: 我在一台笔记本显卡上按预注册的方案做了三组实验：一条短视频广告要让模型看到什么（文案、封面、抽帧、整段视频、帧上识别的文字）才审得准；用合成广告微调的小模型能不能比得上大模型；再拿 300 条另一平台的真实短视频核对。最后对照近一年的研究写了一份调研报告。
evaluation: **视频广告：给模型看什么（96 段）**：96 段视频；每种看法 1 遍；claude-haiku-5-5 走批量接口；本机模型在一台笔记本显卡上跑
**合成广告微调小模型**：有据审核的测试题 168 个判断；真实案例 46 个；每个模型 1 遍；Qwen3-1.7B 加 LoRA，在一台笔记本显卡上训练；claude-haiku-5-5 走批量接口
**另一平台的真实短视频：违不违规（300 条，只公开汇总）**：300 条视频；每个模型 1 遍；claude-haiku-5-5 走批量接口；Qwen3.5-4B 在本机
iteration: 看什么：只给文案时违规大多漏掉；抽帧越多抓得越全；claude-haiku-5-5 看 16 帧时违规全抓到。
本机的 Qwen3.5-4B 只读帧上识别出的文字，和看整段视频一样准，快得多；Qwen3-VL-2B 看 8 帧时把大多数合规广告错拒（28/32）。
微调：Qwen3-1.7B 加 LoRA 比不微调高 11.3 个百分点（有据审核的测试题），和 claude-haiku-5-5 分不出高下；mmBERT 在合成验证集上 173/191，到真实案例只剩 25/46。
真实短视频：Qwen3.5-4B 看画面加文字判对 225/300，claude-haiku-5-5 214/300；后者把更多正常视频标成违规。
result: 审视频广告，关键是让模型看到画面里的字，不一定要看整段视频：帧上识别出的文字就够，而且快得多。用合成广告微调的小模型在相近的题上能追上大模型，但离合成数据越远掉得越多；真实视频上的结论只能算参考，因为题目和标准都来自另一个平台。
limitations: 视频广告和训练数据都是合成的；离合成数据越远，微调模型掉得越多（mmBERT 在真实案例上 25/46）。建议：上线前用平台自己的历史审核结果做一批题再测，按需要补真实数据再训练。
真实短视频来自另一个平台，标准和本项目的政策库不同；两组模型收到的画面大小也不同。建议：换到目标平台的数据和标准上，用同样大小的输入重测。
每个模型每题只跑一遍；有些差别落在区间里，分不出高下。建议：差别小的那几组加题、多跑几遍再定。

name: Policy Model Lab
stack: Python, PyTorch, LoRA fine-tuning (Qwen3), local vision-language models (Qwen3.5, Qwen3-VL), SigLIP 2, mmBERT, OCR, Message Batches API
one_line: Three experiments on reviewing short video ads against policy, all on one laptop GPU, with plans and predictions preregistered.

facts.label: Stack
facts.value: Python, PyTorch, LoRA fine-tuning (Qwen3), local vision-language models (Qwen3.5, Qwen3-VL), SigLIP 2, mmBERT, OCR, Message Batches API

problem: To review a short video ad against policy, what must a model see, and can a small model trained on synthetic ads do the job?
did: On a laptop GPU I ran three preregistered experiments: what a model needs to see of a short video ad (caption, cover, sampled frames, the whole video, text read off the frames) to review it well; whether small models fine-tuned on synthetic ads match a large model; and a check on 300 real short videos from another platform. A survey of the past year's research closes it.
evaluation: **Video ads: what the model is shown (96 videos)**: 96 videos; 1 run per input; claude-haiku-5-5 through the Message Batches API; local models on one laptop GPU

**Small models fine-tuned on synthetic ads**: 168 decisions on Grounded Review's items; 46 real cases; 1 run per model; Qwen3-1.7B with LoRA trained on one laptop GPU; claude-haiku-5-5 through the Message Batches API
**Real short videos from another platform: violating or not (300, totals only)**: 300 videos; 1 run per model; claude-haiku-5-5 through the Message Batches API; Qwen3.5-4B locally
iteration: What to show: with the caption only most violations are missed; more frames catch more; claude-haiku-5-5 with 16 frames caught every violation.
Locally, Qwen3.5-4B reading only the text off the frames is as accurate as watching the video and much faster; Qwen3-VL-2B with 8 frames rejected most compliant ads (28/32).

Fine-tuning: Qwen3-1.7B with LoRA gains 11.3 points over the untuned model on Grounded Review's items and is too close to call against claude-haiku-5-5; mmBERT scores 173/191 on the synthetic validation set but 25/46 on real cases.
Real short videos: Qwen3.5-4B with frames and text was right on 225/300, claude-haiku-5-5 on 214/300; the latter flagged more fine videos.
result: For video ads the key is letting the model see the words in the picture, not necessarily the whole video: the text read off the frames is enough and much faster. Small models fine-tuned on synthetic ads catch up with the large model on similar items but fall further behind the further they are from the synthetic data; the real-video results are indicative only, since the items and the standard come from another platform.
limitations: The video ads and training data are synthetic; the further from them, the more the tuned models drop (mmBERT on real cases: 25/46). Recommendation: Before release, build items from the platform's own past decisions and test again; retrain with real data where needed.

The real short videos come from another platform with a different standard, and the two models received frames of different sizes. Recommendation: Re-test on the target platform's data and standard, with the same input size for every model.
One run per model per item; some differences fall within the intervals and cannot be separated. Recommendation: Add items and runs for the close comparisons before deciding.

name: 模型裁判校准
stack: Python、批量接口、Cohen's kappa 和自助区间、质检 Agent（两个工具）
one_line: 检验一个模型裁判能信到什么程度。

facts.label: 技术
facts.value: Python、批量接口、Cohen's kappa 和自助区间、质检 Agent（两个工具）

problem: 用模型当裁判打分省事，可它能信到什么程度；哪些检查可以交给它，哪些该用脚本，哪些必须留给人。
did: 我把一个模型裁判分别和三种标准比：出题时定好的答案、监管和法院的结论、公开数据集自带的人工评分；再定出哪些检查交给脚本、哪些交给裁判、哪些留给人，并做了一个带验收标准的质检 Agent。方案、冻结的文件和预测跑前写好。
evaluation: **裁判提示词 v1 到 v4（开发集）**：开发集；每版每题 1 遍；claude-haiku-5-5，effort medium，批量接口
**定好答案的判断题（测试集，三次判断取多数）**：711 道；每题判三次，取多数；claude-haiku-5-5，effort medium，批量接口；提示词 v2
**监管和法院的结论（46 条真实广告）**：46 条广告；每条判三次，取多数；claude-haiku-5-5，effort medium，批量接口
**公开数据集自带的人工评分**：Judge's Verdict 200 道；SummEval 每个维度 120 条摘要；WMT MQM 240 句；每题判三次；claude-haiku-5-5，effort medium，批量接口
**规则、裁判和复核队列怎么分工（711 道）**：711 道，其中 390 道含错误；每种接法 1 遍；claude-haiku-5-5，effort medium，批量接口
**加废话、加保证语会不会骗过裁判（368 道）**：368 道；每种改法 1 遍；claude-haiku-5-5，effort medium，批量接口
**质检 Agent 和验收标准**：239 条记录；模拟批次；每条 1 遍；claude-haiku-5-5，effort medium，批量接口
iteration: 裁判提示词 v1 到 v4：v2 在开发集上 0.976（v1 0.860），采用；v3 打平、v4 更严，都不采用。
对定好的答案几乎全对；对监管和法院的结论，要靠外部证据的那一半明显差。
对公开数据集的人工评分：和每位标注员的一致率 67.3%，落在标注员彼此之间的范围里；流畅度这类主观项和专家相关最低（0.408）。
规则、裁判、人工分工：先规则再裁判、拿不准的送人工，比只用裁判漏得少，也更便宜。
质检 Agent 查出全部错误记录（119/119），正确记录误报 7/120；验收标准在错误率百分之二的批次上没达到目标，在百分之十的批次上达标，两个目标只达到一个。
result: 模型裁判在答案清楚、能对回原文的检查上可以放心用，能用规则查的交给脚本更稳；要靠外部证据的结论和主观质量评分，裁判和人差得多，应该留给人。裁判自己说“拿不准”的那部分错得多，正好可以拿来决定送人工。
limitations: 判断题来自同一组项目的存档答案，错误是植入的；“论证成错误结论”这类错误样本由 `eval/gen_flips.py` 生成，生成时用的是同一个模型，裁判认得自己写法的偏差没有排除。建议：上线前用真实业务里已经有结论的记录再校准一次，错误样本换不同来源。
监管和法院的结论只有 46 条，要靠外部证据的只有 11 条；区间很宽。建议：这类结论直接留给人，或者先补齐外部证据再交裁判。
验收标准在错误率百分之二的批次上只放行了 86.6%，没达到事先定的至少九成；百分之十的批次放行 9.4%，达标。质检 Agent 的误报让标记率变模糊，事后看，单靠调标记率门槛两个目标同时达不到。建议：只把复核确认过的标记算进放行门槛（还没测过），再在模拟批次上重测。
headline: 和出题时定好的答案一致 702/711，植入的错误抓到 385/390
监管和法院结论：从广告本身能看出的 33/35，要靠外部证据的只有 6/11

name: Judge Calibration
stack: Python, Message Batches API, Cohen's kappa with bootstrap intervals, a quality-check agent with two tools
one_line: Measures how far one model judge can be trusted, against three standards kept apart: items with answers fixed when they were built (review opinions, resume verdicts, revision advice), regulator and court decisions on real ads, and the human ratings that ship with public datasets (Judge's Verdict, SummEval, WMT MQM Chinese to English).

facts.label: Stack
facts.value: Python, Message Batches API, Cohen's kappa with bootstrap intervals, a quality-check agent with two tools

problem: A model judge is convenient, but how far can it be trusted, which checks can it take, which belong to a script, and which must stay with people?
did: I measured one model judge against three standards kept apart: answers fixed when the items were built, regulator and court decisions, and the human ratings that ship with public datasets; then set which checks go to a script, a judge or a person, and built a quality-check agent with an acceptance standard. The plan, frozen files and predictions were written before the runs.
evaluation: **Judge prompts v1 to v4 (development split)**: Development split; 1 run per item per version; claude-haiku-5-5, effort medium, Message Batches API
**Items with fixed answers (test split, majority of three judgments)**: 711 items; Three judgments per item, majority taken; claude-haiku-5-5, effort medium, Message Batches API; prompt v2
**Regulator and court decisions (46 real ads)**: 46 ads; Three judgments per ad, majority taken; claude-haiku-5-5, effort medium, Message Batches API

**Human ratings that ship with public datasets**: 200 Judge's Verdict items; 120 SummEval summaries per dimension; 240 WMT MQM segments; Three judgments per item; claude-haiku-5-5, effort medium, Message Batches API
**Rules, judge and a review queue (711 items)**: 711 items, 390 of them wrong; 1 run per arm; claude-haiku-5-5, effort medium, Message Batches API
**Does padding or assurance sway the judge? (368 items)**: 368 items; 1 run per change; claude-haiku-5-5, effort medium, Message Batches API
**Quality-check agent and acceptance standard**: 239 records; simulated batches; 1 run per record; claude-haiku-5-5, effort medium, Message Batches API
iteration: Judge prompt v1 to v4: v2 scored 0.976 on the development split (v1 0.860) and was adopted; v3 tied and v4 was stricter, neither adopted.
Against fixed answers the judge is almost always right; against regulator and court decisions it is clearly weaker where outside evidence decides.
Against published human ratings: agreement with each annotator 67.3%, within the range annotators reach with one another; subjective dimensions such as fluency correlate least with experts (0.408).
Splitting the work: rules first, then the judge, with unsure items to people, misses less than the judge alone and costs less.

The quality-check agent caught every wrong record (119/119) and flagged 7/120 correct ones; the acceptance standard missed its target on batches with a two-percent error rate and met it on ten-percent batches, one target out of two.
result: A model judge can be trusted on checks with clear answers that trace back to the text, and rule-checkable parts are safer with a script; decisions that turn on outside evidence and subjective quality ratings stay far from people and should stay with them. The judge's own "unsure" marks the items it gets wrong most often, which makes it a good signal for sending items to people.
limitations: The items come from the same set of projects' stored answers and the errors are planted; "argued to a wrong conclusion" samples were produced by `eval/gen_flips.py` with the same model, so a bias towards its own writing is not ruled out. Recommendation: Before use, calibrate again on real records with settled outcomes, with error samples from other sources.

Only 46 regulator and court decisions, 11 of them turning on outside evidence; the intervals are wide. Recommendation: Leave such decisions to people, or gather the outside evidence before handing them to a judge.

The acceptance standard passed only 86.6% of two-percent batches, short of the at-least-nine-in-ten target set beforehand; ten-percent batches passed 9.4%, meeting theirs. The agent's false flags blur the flag rate, and looking back, no flag-rate threshold alone meets both targets. Recommendation: Count only flags confirmed on review towards the threshold (not yet tested), then test again on simulated batches.

name: 标注 Agent 工具箱
stack: Python、批量接口、BM25 检索、配对自助检验、五个 Agent Skill（只用标准库）
one_line: 一个换一套规则和案例就能接新任务的内容标注 Agent，配一整套用证据调它的工具：预注册的 A/B 对照、每个标签的精确率和召回率（带区间）、混淆和切片、失败样本根因表，以及按根因改版后在没用过的样本上验证。

facts.label: 技术
facts.value: Python、批量接口、BM25 检索、配对自助检验、五个 Agent Skill（只用标准库）

problem: 标注 Agent 怎么设计标得最好，错在哪些标签、哪类样本上，为什么错，改了以后在新样本上还成不成立。
did: 我做了一个通用的内容标注 Agent：换一个放规则和案例的文件夹就能接新任务。用两个任务、五种做法做预注册的 A/B 对照，算每个标签的精确率和召回率、混淆和切片；把最好的做法的失败样本归到五类根因，按根因改出第二版，再在没用过的测试集上检验。常用的分析做成了五个 Agent Skill。
evaluation: **开发集第一轮：Agent 第一步用不用工具**：点评开发集 40 条；每条每种做法 1 遍；claude-haiku-5-5，effort low，批量接口
**测试集 A：五种做法**：广告 119 条；点评 201 条；每条每种做法 1 遍；claude-haiku-5-5，effort low，批量接口
**测试集 A：预注册的对照（后一种减前一种，微平均 F1）**：广告 119 条；点评 201 条；每条每种做法 1 遍；区间按题目自助重抽样 2,000 次；claude-haiku-5-5，effort low，批量接口
**根因：完整 Agent 在测试集 A 上的错误判断**：点评 165 条里的错误判断；广告 4 条里的错误判断；每个错误判断归类 2 次；claude-haiku-5-5，批量接口
**按根因改的第二版：没用过的测试集 B**：广告 118 条；点评 199 条（测试集 B，之前没用过）；每条每个版本 1 遍；区间按题目自助重抽样；claude-haiku-5-5，effort low，批量接口
iteration: 开发集第一轮：只把检索案例的工具交给 Agent 时，它在 40 条点评上第一步一次也没调用（0/40），只给规则工具时 36/40；检索改成流程里固定的一步。
测试集 A：查规则是最大的一步（广告 +0.157，点评 +0.083）；检索相似案例两个任务都有用；自查只在点评上测出提升，每千条点评的费用从 0.91 美元升到 1.59 美元。
整本规则放进提示词，广告上已到 0.878；Agent 比它高的那部分只在点评上测出来。
根因：点评上 406 个错误判断，最多的是标签歧义（158）；能改的是提示词缺陷、规则冲突和模型能力。
第二版只改根因表指出的地方：点评在测试集 B 上测出提升，采用；广告区间碰到 0，不采用。
result: 让 Agent 先读规则、再看相似案例，是标注质量最大的来源；自查只在标签多、边界细的任务上值得多花的钱。一个任务能标到多准，先受标准标签本身的限制：点评数据里不少“错误”是可两读或漏标的标签，这部分应该交给定标准的人，而不是继续调提示词。按根因改版要在没用过的样本上再验一次，没测出提升的就不上。
limitations: 每种做法每条只跑了一次；模型采样带来的波动不在按题目重抽样的区间里，几处差别离边界很近（点评上查规则对整本规则、一半一半案例库、广告的第二版）。建议：上线前对离边界近的几组多跑几次，确认结论不变。
广告的题目和广告规则出自同一组项目（有据审核、审核模型实验），答案在写广告时定好，不是独立标注员定的；完整 Agent 在广告上已接近满分。建议：接真实业务前，用业务里已有结论的样本另建测试集。
点评的标准标签漏掉了一些提及：测试集 A 的 201 条点评里，有 7 条含有在训练集里几乎总伴随某个标签的词，却没有那个标签；根因里还有 158 个判断归为标签歧义。点评上的精确率受这个限制，Agent 的一部分“错误”可能是数据集该有的标签。建议：把可两读或漏标的样本整理给定标准的一方，先统一标注口径，再比较做法。
合成点评比真实点评短，而且是照 Agent 读的同一本规则生成的；换一种生成方式，真实对合成的结论可能不同。建议：用不同的生成提示或模型再造一个案例库，重做这组对照。

name: Labelling Agent Kit
stack: Python, Message Batches API, BM25 retrieval, paired bootstrap tests, five Agent Skills (standard library only)
one_line: A content-labelling agent that plugs into any labelling task through a folder of rules and cases, and the kit to tune it with evidence: preregistered A/B experiments, per-label precision and recall with intervals, confusion and slices, a root-cause table of failures, and a revision checked on items it never saw.

facts.label: Stack
facts.value: Python, Message Batches API, BM25 retrieval, paired bootstrap tests, five Agent Skills (standard library only)

problem: How should a labelling agent be built to label best, where and why does it fail, and does a fix still hold on new items?
did: I built one content-labelling agent that takes on a new task through a folder of rules and cases. Two tasks and five arms go through preregistered A/B comparisons, with per-label precision and recall, confusion and slices; the best arm's failures are sorted into five root causes, a second version is built from them and checked on a test set nothing was tuned on. The common analyses are packaged as five Agent Skills.
evaluation: **Development round one: does the agent's first turn use a tool?**: 40 dev reviews; 1 run per item and arm; claude-haiku-5-5, effort low, Message Batches API
**Test A: five arms**: 119 ads; 201 reviews; 1 run per item and arm; claude-haiku-5-5, effort low, Message Batches API

**Test A: preregistered comparisons (B minus A, micro F1)**: 119 ads; 201 reviews; 1 run per item and arm; intervals from 2,000 item bootstrap resamples; claude-haiku-5-5, effort low, Message Batches API
**Root causes: the full agent's wrong decisions on test A**: Wrong decisions on 165 reviews and on 4 ads; 2 classifications per wrong decision; claude-haiku-5-5, Message Batches API

**The revision built from root causes: unseen test B**: 118 ads; 199 reviews (test B, unused before); 1 run per item and version; item bootstrap intervals; claude-haiku-5-5, effort low, Message Batches API
iteration: Development round one: with the case tools only offered, the agent's first turn called no tool on 40 reviews (0/40), against 36/40 with the rule tools alone; retrieval became a fixed step of the flow.

Test A: reading the rules is the largest step (ads +0.157, reviews +0.083); retrieved cases help on both tasks; the self-check is a measured gain on reviews only and raises the cost per 1,000 reviews from US$0.91 to US$1.59.
Putting the whole rulebook in the prompt already reaches 0.878 on ads; the agent's lead over it is measured only on reviews.
Root causes: of 406 wrong decisions on reviews, label ambiguity is the largest class (158); the fixable classes are prompt defects, rule conflicts and model capability.
The revision changes only what the root-cause table points to: a measured gain on reviews in test B, adopted; on ads the interval reaches 0, not adopted.
result: Reading the rules first and then similar cases is where most of the labelling quality comes from; a self-check is worth its cost only on tasks with many fine-grained labels. How well a task can be labelled is bounded first by its gold labels: many "errors" on the review data are labels that read either way or were left out, which belongs with whoever sets the standard, not with more prompt tuning. A revision built from root causes needs a check on unseen items, and one with no measured gain does not ship.
limitations: Each arm labelled each item once; sampling variance is not in the item-bootstrap intervals, and several differences sit close to the edge (rules versus the whole rulebook on reviews, the half-and-half library, the ads revision). Recommendation: Before relying on the close calls, run them several more times and confirm they hold.

The ad items come from the same projects as the ad rulebook (Grounded Review and Policy Model Lab), with answers fixed by construction rather than by independent annotators; the full agent is near the ceiling on ads. Recommendation: Before real use, build a test set from business items with settled outcomes.

The review gold labels leave out some mentions: 7 of the 201 test A reviews contain a phrase that almost always comes with a label in the training split, yet lack that label; 158 decisions were classed as label ambiguity. Precision on reviews is bounded by this, and some of the agent's "errors" may be labels the dataset arguably should have. Recommendation: Hand the ambiguous or unlabelled cases to whoever sets the standard, settle the labelling rules first, then compare arms.

The synthetic reviews are shorter than real ones and were generated from the same rulebook the agent reads; a different generator could change the real-versus-synthetic result. Recommendation: Build another library with a different generator or prompt and repeat the comparison.

name: Agent 评测台
stack: Python、批量接口、过程记录和逐步规则检查、evidence-check、agentevals、Inspect AI 日志
one_line: 评一个会调工具的 Agent 每一步做了什么，不只看最后的答案。

facts.label: 技术
facts.value: Python、批量接口、过程记录和逐步规则检查、evidence-check、agentevals、Inspect AI 日志

problem: 会调工具的 Agent 只看最后答案对不对不够：它每一步做了什么，上线前的检查能拦住哪些错，失败从哪一步开始，改了以后会不会把别处弄坏。
did: 我给三个已有的、会调工具的 Agent 新写了 46 道题，每题跑三次，把每一步记下来；评分按理解、规划、工具调用、知识引用、结果五个阶段写成规则，再加上线前的自动关卡和失败归因表。看完基线后，跑之前先写下两个修复的预测，再在整组题上做回归重测。
evaluation: **基线：三个 Agent 照原样运行**：46 道题：广告审核 20、经营分析 18、创作流程 8；每题 3 次；claude-haiku-5-5，effort medium；第一次走普通接口，第二、三次走批量接口
**上线前的自动关卡和失败归因（基线）**：基线 138 次试验里失败的那些；每题 3 次；claude-haiku-5-5，effort medium
**装 Skill 和不装（创作流程）**：8 道题；每题 3 次；claude-haiku-5-5，effort medium，批量接口
**预注册的两个修复和回归重测**：广告审核 20 道；经营分析 18 道；每题 3 次；claude-haiku-5-5，effort medium，批量接口
**判官校准和总花费**：校准答案 12 条；基线答案 88 条；每个答案判 2 遍；claude-haiku-5-5，effort medium
iteration: 基线任务成功：广告审核 53/60、经营分析 47/54、创作流程 21/24；广告审核引的原话和条款每次都对，错在结论和类别。
关卡：事先预测关卡能拦下大多数失败，结果只拦下 1/17；经营分析的数字核对拦下的大多是对的报告。
不装 Skill：创作流程成功率从 21/24 掉到 8/24；给致死火灾做营销选题这种错，来源核对也放过了。
修复广告审核：审核轮误调建议工具从 36/60 降到 0/60，输出 token -15%；任务成功没测出差别，提升在过程上。
修复经营分析：门店下线定位到商家 3/6 → 6/6，按事先的规则采用；回归重测发现另一道退款题被定位得过细，下一步把规则从提示词搬进代码。
result: 上线前的自动关卡查的是形式：引文是不是原话、数字有没有出处、时长对不对；它们放过的，正是判断上的错。会调工具的 Agent 要按步骤评，才能看清失败从哪里开始、哪些是题目本身的问题。照失败写的修复要先写下预测，再在整组题上回归重测，否则修好一处、弄坏另一处也看不出来。
limitations: 每题只跑三次，题目是为这套评测新写的，区间很宽：经营分析任务成功 47/54（87.0%，95% 区间 75.6–93.6%）；按题比较只靠三次试验。建议：重要的结论多跑几次、加新题再确认。
题目是合成或虚构的，出自运行它的同一个项目；有两道题的题目或答案本身有问题，照实留在分数里。建议：给那两道题改名或重建后重跑，并用真实业务里已有结论的样本另建一组题。
判官和被测的 Agent 是同一个模型，指南在平静的周上有漏洞；判断项不影响任务成功，也没有另做人工评分。建议：补上指南的漏洞，换一个不同的模型做第二判官对照。
两个修复只在写它们的那组题上验证过；时延只来自基线第一次走普通接口的试验，每题一次。建议：用新题检验修复能不能推广，再把规则搬进代码后重测退款类的题。

name: Agent Trace Eval
stack: Python, Message Batches API, step traces with rule checks, evidence-check, agentevals, Inspect AI logs
one_line: Evaluates what a tool-using agent does at every step, not only its final answer.

facts.label: Stack
facts.value: Python, Message Batches API, step traces with rule checks, evidence-check, agentevals, Inspect AI logs

problem: Grading only the final answer of a tool-using agent is not enough: what did each step do, which errors do release checks stop, where does a failure start, and does a fix break something else?
did: I wrote 46 new tasks for three existing tool-using agents, ran each three times and recorded every step; scoring is written as rules over five stages (understanding, planning, tool calls, knowledge and citation, result), with release gates and a failure attribution table on top. After the base run, two fixes were registered with predictions before they ran, then re-tested on every task of their family.
evaluation: **Base: three agents run unchanged**: 46 tasks: 20 ad review, 18 business review, 8 creator workflow; 3 trials per task; claude-haiku-5-5, effort medium; trial 1 standard API, trials 2 and 3 Message Batches API
**Release gates and failure attribution (base)**: The failed trials among 138 base trials; 3 trials per task; claude-haiku-5-5, effort medium
**Skills against no skills (creator workflow)**: 8 tasks; 3 trials per task; claude-haiku-5-5, effort medium, Message Batches API
**Two registered fixes and the regression run**: 20 ad review tasks; 18 business review tasks; 3 trials per task; claude-haiku-5-5, effort medium, Message Batches API
**Judge calibration and total spend**: 12 calibration answers; 88 base answers; 2 judgements per answer; claude-haiku-5-5, effort medium
iteration: Base task success: ad review 53/60, business review 47/54, creator workflow 21/24; ad review quotes and clauses were always right, its errors are decisions and categories.
Gates: they were predicted to catch most failures and caught 1/17; most reports the business number check held were correct ones.
Without skills: creator workflow success fell from 21/24 to 8/24; promotional cards on a fatal fire passed the source check.
Ad fix: the advice tool called in a review turn went from 36/60 to 0/60, output tokens -15%; no measured change in task success, the gain is in the process.

Business fix: store closures located at the merchant 3/6 → 6/6, adopted by the registered rule; the regression run found a refund task now located too finely, so the next step moves the rules from the prompt into code.
result: Release gates check form: quotes are the item's own words, numbers have a source, timings fit; what they let through is errors of judgement. A tool-using agent needs scoring by step to see where a failure starts and which failures belong to the task itself. A fix written from a failure needs predictions first and a regression run over the whole family; otherwise one fix breaking something else goes unseen.
limitations: Three trials per task over tasks written for this bench, so intervals are wide: business review task success 47/54 (87.0%, 95% CI 75.6–93.6%); per-task comparisons rest on three trials each. Recommendation: Confirm the important findings with more trials and new tasks.

The tasks are synthetic or fictional and come from the same project that runs them; two have a problem in the task or the key, kept in the scores. Recommendation: Fix and re-run those two tasks, and build another set from real work with settled outcomes.

The judge is the model under evaluation, and its guide has a gap on quiet weeks; judged items do not affect task success, and no human ratings were collected. Recommendation: Close the gap in the guide and add a second judge from a different model.

The fixes were checked only on the tasks they were written for; latency comes from the base standard-API trials only, one per task. Recommendation: Test the fixes on new tasks, and re-test the refund tasks after the rules move into code.

name: 马来西亚电子类目招商样本
stack: Python、DuckDB、SQL、Excel（openpyxl）、evidence-check、公开页面存档
one_line: 给类目团队的招商“第一周作业”：行业洞察、本地品牌、经销商和连锁店的打分商家池、按品类的资质清单、入驻跟进表、头 30 天的 SQL 和触达模板。
problem: 类目团队招商的第一周：市场什么样、先联系哪些商家、凭什么，每类产品要哪些认证，入驻怎么跟进；每条理由都要拿得出公开出处。
did: 我先查了现成的店铺排行工具：它们只排已经在平台上的商家，回答不了“还没进来或还没做起来的商家里先招谁”。于是用公开来源补这一块：存下官方、市场和品牌的公开页面，写出行业洞察和按品类的资质清单；打分规则在填写任何一行之前写好并冻结，按它给本地品牌、经销商和连锁店排出先后；再配上入驻跟进表、头 30 天的 SQL 和触达模板；充电器、充电宝和数据线单独做了一页深挖；另写了进团队以后先换哪些公开字段、怎么用结果检验打分权重，附校准脚本。每条事实和商家池的每一格都用 evidence-check 对回存档原文。
evaluation: **全文核对：每条带出处的说法**：全部带出处的说法；每次构建都跑；evidence-check 0.5.0 的核对脚本；不调用模型
**商家池：按冻结的规则打分**：商家池全部商家；每次构建都跑；`pool/build.py` 照规则打分，先校验规则文件的指纹
**来源：存档的公开页面**：全部存档页面；读取一次，可用 `tools/refetch.py` 重新保存；不调用模型
iteration: 打分规则：第一版在填写任何一行之前就换成第二版，重点改成“在别处已经卖得好、内容电商上还没做大”的本地商家；变更记录写在规则文件里，规则一改，构建就拒绝打分。
核对：引文不在页面里、数字不在引文里、引文里没有能当证据的词（例如认证要有 SIRIM、MCMC 或能源委员会），构建都会停下。
result: 招商名单的每条理由都能当面翻到原文：先联系谁、为什么、要什么资质，都有公开出处。规则先写死再打分，排序就不会跟着手上的名单走；拿不到的信息照实写“公开来源里没找到”，第一次联系前再查。
